name: ui-liquid-tab-bridge
title: Liquid Tab Bridge
description: Giọt chỉ báo chạy sang tab mới, giãn dài theo tốc độ, để lại một giọt nhỏ ở chỗ cũ nối bằng cầu chất lỏng mảnh dần; gần tới nơi cầu đứt, giọt cũ tan, giọt mới rung khi đáp.

moworks.author: takayu

options.speedFull: units a second for the full stretch (600)
options.snap: share of the trip the neck snaps (0.88)
options.wobble: landing wobble (0.16 × e^(−7 t) × sin 26 t)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-material-liquid-tab-bridge, written here): Blob r15 travels 128 px (A to C) in 0.9 s power2.inOut, stretched by speed (scaleX 1 + min(0.42, v / 1500 px/s), scaleY inverse). A droplet stays at the start shrinking r15 → 6, joined by a neck 11 → 2 px wide; at 88 % of the trip the neck snaps, the droplet shrinks to 0 in 0.32 s (power2.in) and a 22 px tail tip retracts in 0.18 s (power2.out). Landing wobble 16 % × e^(−7 t) × sin(26 t). Reverse at 2.5 s. Tab icons flip to dark under the blob. Params: travel (128 px, 0.9 s, power2.inOut) · stretch (tối đa 1.42) · neck (11 → 2 px) · snap (88 %) · wobble (16 %).
